title: Hāna Habitat for Humanity homes stalled
summary: A council member said on April 7 that one affordable housing project expects about 330 days to get its permits. A day earlier he said a building permit that takes about three months in Lahaina is taking 330 days. The group plans 25 homes, built five a year for five years, and a testifier said the streets and water meters are in while the project waits on electric poles.
